summary: Administrators share one list of Pending changes, cannot overwrite each other, and can require a second approver.

new.title: Pending changes shared by every administrator
new.text: Every administrator now sees the same Pending changes, updated every few seconds, with who staged each change. Your browser's earlier changes join the shared list automatically.

new.title: Rows are locked while staged
new.text: When a colleague has staged a change to a row, nobody else can change it until it is committed or discarded. You are told who holds it.

new.title: An optional second approver
new.text: A SuperAdmin can require that sensitive changes, or all changes, are committed by a different administrator than the one who staged them.

fixes.title: Cancel all pending discards only yours
fixes.text: Cancel all pending now discards only your own changes; your colleagues' changes stay. A commit asks first when it includes colleagues' changes.
